Reported lifetime-deviation arithmetic supports rounded96.97%, not annual outage, capture efficiency, risk probability or retention.

equations.interpretation: Analyst one-year unit example only. Full CS coefficient also needs L, discount/time basis and economic source correspondence.

variables: I sources; K=Kseq union Kutil sites; T equal annual commissioning periods. Case820 sources/eight sites/25 periods is an attributed dataset, not current commercial availability.

F forecast time periods, tau window start, Gamma=min(tau+|F|-1,|T|) endpoint. Printed t in Gamma needs a range/set definition. I_A unused and I_D deployed source sets change before storage summation in both algorithms.
Lat/Lon and source types are inputs. No native coordinate/distance/source-sink identity matrix supplied; maps are not exact geospatial data.
E_i annual emissions inkt/year and selected plant capacity equals full E_i. No separate capture efficiency, residual emission or utility penalty model.
mu_i,t is binary commissioning indicator, at most one start. Nomenclature binary entry omits t but mentions periodt; not a permanent active flag each year.
h_i,k,t annual pipeline capacity. CT listed as NPV of pipeline but multiplies h; cost-per-capacity and distance scaling require supplement. Pipeline terms lack sum_k, leaving k free.
y_i,k,t and y_i,k,t,omega are annual flows starting at t for L periods, held constant by cohort. xsl is annualized undesired uncaptured cohort amount, not measured leakage or outage.

St_k and St_k,omega are resource amounts in capacity constraints; latter called maximum yearly amount in symbols. L*sum annual flows requires stock units; dividing a yearly rate by L would not be an annual physical constraint.
L plant operational lifetime is not numerically specified in main PDF.25-year deployment horizon is distinct; full-life commitments can extend beyond2050.
CI is initial investment NPV; CO lifetime operating NPV. CSt, R and CS are cumulative discounted coefficients for storage, EOR revenue and social costs across L periods from startt.
B_t is commissioning-period allocation of whole-life commitments. It does not by itself reconstruct future annual cash expenditure; Eq8/14/26 enforce each scenario, not only expected storage costs.
CS social cost42dollars/ton and E inkt/year require consistent1000 conversion plus lifetime/discount coefficients.3% discount and base currency/year/cost schedules require original sources.
Eq7/13 minus(CI−CO) raises objective with operating cost; Eq1/19/25/prose use minus(CI+CO). Eq25 CC^Soc lacks explicit link to CS. No silent repair.

Omega scenarios, p_omega probabilities, Omega_N sampled set. iid scenarios are joint draws; independence between different sinks is not documented. D_k,omega and St_k,omega both appear as storage-realization notation.
M10 batches,N25 scenarios,Nbar5000 evaluations are stated. Samples, seeds,CDF interpolation,joint correlations, persistence between windows and holdout/candidate-selection independence are missing.

X consists of mu/h deployment decisions, common across scenarios. Only y/xsl carry omega. Extra first-stage pipe links are not scenario-contingent construction unless native information structure adds it.

f objective/value function and sample arguments are not supplied as executable recourse mappings. X*,Xhat,Zhat,U_MN and L_Nbar distinguish true optimum, candidate and empirical estimators; feasible heuristics do not establish SAA upper bounds.
1% Gurobi optimality gap is reported, not zero gap or confidence level. Statistical confidence needs solver bounds, variance/interval and independent evaluation, not only large sample counts.
4795/145.24kt are reported mean deviations over all plant lives.96.97% is relative reduction of those statistics, not probability of failure, annual loss or retained fraction.
Figure6a is new annual commissioning capacity, Figure6b/8 direct regional emission rates, maps are approximate topology. No exact25-year arrays or cumulative retained mass recovered.
Full nonnegative continuous domains are not explicitly listed in equations; physical amounts suggest them. Synthetic examples disclose nonnegative domains and arbitrary monetary/stock units.
EOR revenue and social damage monetization do not account for all oil/capture/transport/storage lifecycle emissions. No complete same-case utility inventory or pressure-calibrated annual rate.
